I changed this to pass the sanitized update_rate_ to the ResourceManager instead of the raw parameter value. With the fallback logic, params_->update_rate could still be 0 while update_rate_ had been corrected to 100, so passing the raw value would make the ControllerManager and ResourceManager use different rates.


However, since you prefer rejecting zero through the generated parameter validator and removing the fallback, this change is no longer necessary. I’ll restore the original cast and use the strict gt<>: 0 validation.
